items.statement: The submission preserves the supplied neutral singlet molecular identities and explicitly documents conformer handling, geometry convergence/stationarity, amine-site mapping and descriptor definitions.
items.expected: Preserve each neutral singlet graph and report independent conformer/stationarity evidence for three diamines; TMC is context only. Vertical N+/-1 electron probes are legal auxiliary states, not wrong target charge. Map both amine N sites and distinguish primary measurement conditions from sensitivity methods.

items.statement: Ring-plane angle and continuous linker torsions are explicitly different, atom-mapped geometry observables.
items.expected: Re-extract the acute least-squares six-carbon plane angle and all public bonded-path torsions from submitted validated geometry. Check map IDs, plane residuals, sign convention and PFMB center bond 3-12. No nearest-target selector.

items.statement: Source global nucleophilicity indices are ODA 4.26, 6FODA 3.68 and PFMB 3.56 eV; these are not local atomic descriptors.
items.expected: Compare the identity-bound HOMO-derived global index only, using the public fixed TCE scale and primary method. Check the arithmetic N=HOMO-(-9.1212). Separately assess local definitions, units, both N sites and provenance; never score ALIE/ESP/Fukui/local N against these global numbers.

items.statement: The source global-index ordering is ODA > 6FODA > PFMB; the optimized diamines are noncoplanar. Source four-atom angles 75.2/81.6/77.1 degrees do not define a unique ring-plane observable.
items.expected: Assess global ordering and analyze local-descriptor disagreements. Require auditable noncoplanar geometry (or evidence-backed contrary result), not agreement of ring-plane angles with ambiguous source four-atom numbers.

items.statement: The fixed diamine set has a reproducible comparative reactivity analysis from the global TCE-referenced nucleophilicity index, separately defined local indicators and mapped geometry. An evidence-backed disagreement with the source ordering remains admissible.

items.condition: Changes a scored diamine neutral-singlet graph/identity or fails to map it; explicitly documented vertical N+/-1 probes are not target identity changes.
Reported descriptor values or ordering have no calculation provenance, convergence evidence or site definition.
The report treats the gas-phase descriptor as a measured experimental reaction rate or claims polymer/membrane behavior that was not calculated.
Uses local N, ALIE, ESP, Fukui or N+/-1 total-energy differences as the global HOMO-derived index, or treats an unrelated torsion as the defined plane angle.

evidence.source: Main paper, Results: DFT descriptors and nucleophilicity indices ODA 4.26 eV > 6FODA 3.68 eV > PFMB 3.56 eV.
Supplementary/reviewer response R2.1 and R2.4: conformer search, gas-phase DFT route, atom-defined dihedral and descriptor calculation context.
Supplementary/reviewer response R1.3: revised multidescriptor interpretation and ODA > 6FODA > PFMB.

Approved observable clarification: main paper p3 global N; official Supplementary Note 8 pp10-11 (117-page 41467_2025_68049_MOESM1_ESM.pdf), not the local 41-page reviewer-response PDF. Existing group_6 identity-corrected CDFT.txt gives E_HOMO, global N and separate local N. Four-decimal output implies fixed TCE -9.1212 eV. Geometry replay in evaluation/boundary_repair_evidence.json corrects PFMB nonbonded 4-12 selector to 3-12 and separates ring-plane angles from continuous torsions; no DFT rerun or reference-based scoring.
